notes.title: Brazilian Portuguese, Polish and Czech languages are now supported!
notes.content:
There is a new update to Tales of the Orient - The Rising Sun! 

- Added support for Brazilian Portuguese, Polish and Czech languages.
- Bug Fixes and Improvements 
- Added an Extra button on Main Menu, now you can Visit Us on Facebook! =)

The game now supports 7 languages (English, French, German, Brazilian Portuguese, Polish, Czech and Russian). You can change the game language on Options Screen.
